title: Meta Ads
description: Connect a platform-owned Meta credential, validate read-only access, and review sanitized account diagnostics.
forbidden: Agency admin access is required to manage advertising integrations.
connectionSectionDescription: Manage the Meta connection, access token, and Graph API settings.
createDescription: Connections are platform-owned in this release. The access token is encrypted server-side and is never shown after saving.
graphVersionDescription: Changing this version pauses synchronization and requires a fresh read-only validation. The encrypted credential is kept.
overviewDescription: A read-only snapshot of configured connections, discovered accounts, and current controls.

setup.title: Get started with Meta Ads
setup.description: Follow these steps to connect your account and enable reporting.

step1.title: Connect credential
step1.description: Add your Meta account and authenticate.

empty: No Meta advertising connections have been configured.
credentialDescription: Paste a Meta system-user token. It is encrypted server-side; the original value is not returned.
credentialNotConfiguredDescription: Save a system-user token to enable read-only validation.
replaceCredentialPlaceholder: Enter a new token to replace the stored credential
validationDescription: Runs bounded read-only identity, account discovery, and campaign checks. No campaigns or budgets are changed.
syncDescription: Choose which discovered accounts are scheduled for read-only background synchronization. Activation does not publish or change campaigns.
noLinkedAccounts: Validate the connection to discover accounts before enabling sync.
socialIdentitiesDescription: Sanitized Facebook Page and Instagram identities found during the read-only probe.
noSocialIdentities: No Facebook Page or Instagram identities have been discovered yet.

syncStatus.dead_letter: Stopped after repeated failures; re-enable to retry

accountsDescription: These are sanitized provider identities. Grant visibility explicitly before a workspace can consume reporting data.
permissionsDescription: Control what this connection can access in your agency and workspaces.
noAccounts: No ad accounts have been discovered yet.
accountSearch: Search accounts by name or ID
scopeIdsHelp: Comma-separated provider IDs. Leave blank for account-wide access.
financialDescription: Financial authority is separate from report visibility and should be granted only for approved spend workflows.
noActiveGrants: No visibility grants have been created.
noFinancialAuthorities: No financial authorities have been created.
historyDescription: Recent sanitized outcomes and sync errors. Tokens and provider payloads are never shown.
reconciliationDescription: Provider totals, explicit attribution, and completeness are shown separately so a partial read cannot look like a financial mismatch.
zeroValueNote: A dash means zero. Exact zero values remain available to assistive technology.
capabilitiesDescription: The latest sanitized result for each account-level read capability.
noCapabilities: Run validation to record account capability results.

codes.connection_created: Connection created. Add a credential to continue.
codes.credential_stored: Credential encrypted and stored. Validate it before use.
codes.graph_version_updated: Graph API version updated. Synchronization is paused until validation passes.
codes.invalid_graph_api_version: Enter a Graph API version such as v26.0.
codes.connection_revoked: Connection revoked. Reads and active credentials are disabled.
codes.advertising_account_access_revoked: Ad account access revoked and synchronization paused.
codes.workflow_passed: Validation passed; sanitized account discovery completed.
codes.workflow_partial: Validation completed with partial access. Review the diagnostics.
codes.workflow_failed: Validation failed. Review the diagnostics and provider permissions.
codes.advertising_connection_account_not_activ: Connection does not have active account access.
codes.invalid_grant: Choose a valid account, scope, and capability.
codes.invalid_financial_authority: Choose a valid account and scope.
codes.invalid_sync_state: Choose a valid connection and account.
codes.advertising_account_not_in_agency: The account is not part of this agency.
codes.advertising_account_not_active: The advertising account is not active.
codes.workspace_not_in_agency: The workspace is not part of this agency.
codes.unsupported_advertising_capability: That advertising capability is not supported.
codes.advertising_grant_range_invalid: The grant date range is invalid.
codes.advertising_action_failed: The advertising action could not be completed.

diagnostics.missing_permission: A required provider permission is missing.
diagnostics.missing_asset_assignment: The token cannot access the requested Meta asset.
diagnostics.expired_or_revoked: The credential is expired or revoked.
diagnostics.wrong_app_or_account: The credential belongs to a different app or account.
diagnostics.unsupported_field: The provider rejected an unsupported field.
diagnostics.rate_limited: The provider rate-limited this request. Try again later.
diagnostics.no_data: The provider returned no accessible data.

diagnosticFixes.missing_permission: Confirm the Meta app has the required read permissions, then save a refreshed credential and validate again.
diagnosticFixes.missing_asset_assignment: Assign the requested Page or ad account to the system user, then validate again.
diagnosticFixes.expired_or_revoked: Replace the credential with a current Meta system-user token, then validate again.
diagnosticFixes.wrong_app_or_account: Check that the credential belongs to the configured Meta app and intended business, then replace it if needed.
diagnosticFixes.access_tier_restricted: Ask Meta to approve the required access tier or use an account with the approved tier, then validate again.
diagnosticFixes.unsupported_field: Review the configured Graph API version and requested read fields, then validate again.
diagnosticFixes.rate_limited: Wait for the provider limit to clear and retry; reduce concurrent validation or sync activity if it persists.
diagnosticFixes.provider_temporarily_unavailable: Retry after the provider recovers. Do not replace credentials unless the failure changes to an authentication error.
diagnosticFixes.no_data: Confirm the business has an assigned, active asset with readable data, then validate again.
diagnosticFixes.instagram_no_data: No Instagram professional account was found through the approved Page probe. This does not block ad-account validation; assign an active professional account if Instagram data is required.

reporting.title: Advertising reporting
reporting.description: Read-only Meta performance for the accounts explicitly shared with this workspace.
reporting.disabledDescription: This read-only reporting surface is still behind its rollout gate. No advertising data is available here yet.
reporting.noAccessTitle: No advertising account is shared with this workspace
reporting.noAccessDescription: An agency administrator must grant reporting visibility before this workspace can view advertising performance.
reporting.permissionDescription: The selected account is no longer available to this workspace. Ask an agency administrator to review the connection and grants.
reporting.searchPlaceholder: Search campaigns, ad sets, or ads
reporting.invalidRangeDescription: The end date must be on or after the start date, and a report can cover at most 93 days.
reporting.summaryDescription: Authorized results for {account} in the selected period.

dashboard.performanceTrendDescription: Compare two metrics across the selected period. Use the table for exact values.
dashboard.objectiveMixDescription: Spend share and valid results stay separated by objective.
dashboard.campaignExplorerDescription: Start with comparable campaign outcomes, then drill into the detailed tables below.
dashboard.audienceSnapshotDescription: Provider-returned segments for the selected period.
dashboard.noAudienceData: No compatible audience breakdown is available.
dashboard.noSignals: No evidence-backed action is available for this period.

reporting.clientReportDescription: A read-only, workspace-scoped summary of paid performance, pacing, promoted content, and creative health.
reporting.promotedContentDescription: Paid delivery is compared with authorized organic observations for the exact promoted post.
reporting.aiRecommendationsDescription: Generate advisory actions from this authorized report. Recommendations are evidence-linked and never change campaigns or publishing state.
reporting.recommendationsError: Recommendations could not be generated. Check AI enablement and report access, then try again.
reporting.recommendationsUnavailable: The recommendation service is not available.
reporting.decisionDescription: Evidence-backed signals from the authorized campaign, budget, and ad-day data in this period.
reporting.audienceOpportunityDescription: Provider-returned audience rows available for this period.
reporting.noAudienceData: No audience breakdown is available yet.
reporting.campaignSignalDescription: Peer comparison using CTR and CPC when the sample is large enough.
reporting.budgetPacingDescription: Daily-budget pace compared with observed spend; lifetime budgets need campaign dates.
reporting.creativeHealthDescription: Fatigue is flagged only when both comparison periods have enough impressions.
reporting.noComparison: No comparable campaign signal is available for this period.
reporting.noBudgetData: No comparable daily-budget pace is available.
reporting.noFatigueData: No creative fatigue signal is available yet.
reporting.spendTrendDescription: Daily spend across the selected period.
reporting.noSpendData: No daily spend data is available for this period.
reporting.noObjectiveData: No campaign objective data is available for this period.
reporting.promotedPostsDescription: Paid delivery is joined to exact provider post IDs. Combined views add the authorized organic view total to paid impressions; this is not an inferred unique-reach metric.
reporting.promotedPostsTableLabel: Promoted post paid, organic, and combined performance
reporting.adSetsDescription: Authorized ad-set totals derived from canonical ad-day facts.
reporting.adsDescription: Authorized ad totals with provider status and results where available.
reporting.audienceDescription: Provider-returned audience dimensions for the selected period; no demographic or geographic values are inferred.
reporting.audienceUnavailable: Meta did not return an audience breakdown for this period or permission scope.
reporting.dailySpendDescription: Canonical ad-level spend, shown by reporting date.
reporting.campaignsDescription: Campaign totals are calculated from authorized ad-level facts.
reporting.targetingDescription: Targeting returned by Meta for authorized ad sets; delivered audience is shown separately.
reporting.partialDescription: Totals and trends include only the canonical facts received so far. Review synchronization diagnostics before making financial decisions.
reporting.emptyTitle: No advertising data in this period
reporting.emptyDescription: The account is authorized, but no canonical ad-level facts were recorded for the selected dates. Try another range or run a read-only synchronization.
